headline: Silver Loss Widens To 4.86 Percent At 54.63 From 4.45 Percent As Gold Falls To 4,038.6
narrative: Silver fell to 54.63, a 4.86 percent loss, from 54.87 and a 4.45 percent loss, while gold fell to 4,038.6, a 2.68 percent loss, from 4,051.3 and a 2.38 percent loss. Oil eased to 99.21, a 2.12 percent gain, from 99.34 and a 2.25 percent gain. The metals pipe is the cash price of silver and gold, so the wider losses mean the cash value of those metals fell, and the oil pipe is the cash price of crude, so the smaller gain means crude cash value slipped from the prior reading while remaining higher on the day.
author: jordan
